author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: तत्साधयतीति, न तु ज्ञानस्योक्तलक्षणाभावादिति श्लोकत्रयतात्पर्यार्थः । अत्रोक्तमिन्द्रियजयस्य ज्ञानरूपं फलं न साक्षादिति 'रागद्वेषवियुक्तौ'रित्यादौ व्यक्तीभविष्यतीति ज्ञेयम्
translation: V. I, the glorious Lord Krishna. The contemplation must proceed with the perfect understanding that the glorious Lord is the most exalted of all things. In contemplation i.e., in concentrating the mind upon the Lord.
